vocabulary.label: Untap loop
vocabulary.why: an untap engine onto a tap ability worth another go

vocabulary.label: Copy loop
vocabulary.why: a copier onto a permanent worth copying again

vocabulary.label: Blink loop
vocabulary.why: a blink engine onto a permanent that enters for value

vocabulary.label: Sacrifice supply
vocabulary.why: bodies made repeatably into an outlet that wants them

vocabulary.label: Enter-the-battlefield payoff
vocabulary.why: a card that fires when a creature enters, fed by cards that make them enter

vocabulary.label: Death payoff
vocabulary.why: a card that fires when a creature dies, fed by the cards that kill your own

vocabulary.label: Team quality
vocabulary.why: a quality granted to one permanent and spread across the board

vocabulary.label: Tribal payoff
vocabulary.why: a lord or payoff that names the tribe, and the bodies that are it

vocabulary.label: Stat payoff
vocabulary.why: a card that rewards a printed number, and the bodies that carry it

vocabulary.label: Tutor chain
vocabulary.why: finders that fetch the next piece

vocabulary.label: Recursion loop
vocabulary.why: the graveyard filled and brought back, again

vocabulary.label: Extra turns
vocabulary.why: turns taken again, and the cards that find or copy them

vocabulary.label: Draw payoff
vocabulary.why: a card that fires on a draw, fed by the cards that draw

vocabulary.label: Landfall
vocabulary.why: a land drop as the event, and the cards that make more of them

vocabulary.label: Spells cast
vocabulary.why: an instant or sorcery cast as the event
